weeks.content:
The sun warms and lights the earth
Sun safety while playing

Trace my shadow morning and noon
Shadows move with the sun

Sun, torch, lamp, candle
Sort light and dark

Drum, bell, whistle
Loud and soft sorting

Sun is hot, ice is cold
Sort hot and cold pictures

Ice melts in the sun
Water becomes ice in the freezer

Fan, blender, car
Machines make work easy

Roll cars down the ramp
Steep or gentle, which is faster

Build tall towers
Balance scales with blocks

Show my machine or tower
Talk like a scientist
